# @sothikhorn/cambodia-gazetteer

> Cambodia's administrative divisions — 25 provinces, 210 districts, 1,652 communes and 14,570 villages — with Khmer and English names and official NCDD codes, as an offline npm package with TypeScript types, lookups and search. Data: NCDD admin database, 14 October 2024.

- Install: `npm install @sothikhorn/cambodia-gazetteer` (or `pnpm add`, `yarn add`, `bun add`).
- Runs in Node 18+ and in browsers through any bundler, from ESM and CommonJS. No dependencies and no network calls: all data is bundled.
- Every record is `{ code, name, en_name }`. `name` is Khmer and `en_name` is Latin script.

## Functions

- `getProvinces()`: all 25 provinces.
- `getProvince(code)`: a province, or `undefined`.
- `getDistricts(provinceCode?)`: the districts of a province, or all 210 if omitted.
- `getDistrict(code)`: a district with its `province`, or `undefined`.
- `getCommunes(districtCode?)`: the communes of a district, or all 1,652 if omitted.
- `getCommune(code)`: a commune with its `district` and `province`, or `undefined`.
- `getVillages(communeCode?)`: the villages of a commune, or all 14,570 if omitted.
- `getVillage(code)`: a village with its `commune`, `district` and `province`, or `undefined`.
- `lookup(code)`: any record with its parents, plus `level` ("province", "district", "commune" or "village") inferred from the code.
- `search(query, { level?, limit? })`: records whose Khmer or Latin name contains `query`, case-insensitive. Exact matches come first, then prefix matches, then the rest.
- `normalizeCode(code)`, `parentCode(code)`, `levelOf(code)`: code helpers.
- `meta`: `{ datasetVersion, source: { upstream }, counts }`.

## Codes

- Codes are strings. A parent's code is the child's code without its last two digits.
- Provinces 01–09 have no leading zero below province level: Banteay Meanchey `01`, district `102`, commune `10201`, village `1020101`.
- Provinces 10–25 use 4-, 6- and 8-digit codes: Phnom Penh `12`, district `1201`, commune `120101`, village `12010101`.
- Every function also accepts zero-padded codes (`"0102"`) and numbers (`102`).

## Examples

```js
import { getDistricts, getVillage, search } from "@sothikhorn/cambodia-gazetteer";

getDistricts("12").length; // 14: the khans of Phnom Penh

const v = getVillage("12010101");
[v.en_name, v.commune.en_name, v.district.en_name, v.province.en_name].join(", ");
// "Phum 1, Tonle Basak, Chamkar Mon, Phnom Penh"

// Village names repeat: 151 villages are named exactly "Thmei", in 24 provinces.
search("Thmei", { level: "village" }).filter((r) => r.en_name === "Thmei").length; // 151
```

## Provinces

| Code | Khmer | English (NCDD spelling) |
|------|-------|---------|
| `01` | បន្ទាយមានជ័យ | Banteay Meanchey |
| `02` | បាត់ដំបង | Battambang |
| `03` | កំពង់ចាម | Kampong Cham |
| `04` | កំពង់ឆ្នាំង | Kampong Chhnang |
| `05` | កំពង់ស្ពឺ | Kampong Speu |
| `06` | កំពង់ធំ | Kampong Thom |
| `07` | កំពត | Kampot |
| `08` | កណ្ដាល | Kandal |
| `09` | កោះកុង | Koh Kong |
| `10` | ក្រចេះ | Kratie |
| `11` | មណ្ឌលគិរី | Mondul Kiri |
| `12` | ភ្នំពេញ | Phnom Penh |
| `13` | ព្រះវិហារ | Preah Vihear |
| `14` | ព្រៃវែង | Prey Veng |
| `15` | ពោធិ៍សាត់ | Pursat |
| `16` | រតនគិរី | Ratanak Kiri |
| `17` | សៀមរាប | Siemreap |
| `18` | ព្រះសីហនុ | Preah Sihanouk |
| `19` | ស្ទឹងត្រែង | Stung Treng |
| `20` | ស្វាយរៀង | Svay Rieng |
| `21` | តាកែវ | Takeo |
| `22` | ឧត្ដរមានជ័យ | Oddar Meanchey |
| `23` | កែប | Kep |
| `24` | ប៉ៃលិន | Pailin |
| `25` | ត្បូងឃ្មុំ | Tboung Khmum |

English names use NCDD spellings, which differ from some common ones: Siemreap (Siem Reap), Mondul Kiri (Mondulkiri), Ratanak Kiri (Ratanakiri), Preah Sihanouk (Sihanoukville), Tboung Khmum (Tbong Khmum). `search` matches the NCDD spelling only, so `search("Siem Reap")` returns the district of that name (`1710`), not the province. For a province, use its code (`getProvince("17")`) or the NCDD spelling.

## Not included

- No coordinates, boundaries or other GIS shapes.
- No postal codes or statistics such as population.
- It doesn't record whether a district is a srok, krong or khan, or whether a commune is a khum or sangkat.
- It's a snapshot from 14 October 2024, so later administrative changes are missing.
- One known gap in the source: village `2010508` has no Latin name (`en_name: ""`).
